description:
YouTube
==
- chore(YouTube - Hide ads): Remove duplicated ads filter
- chore(YouTube - Settings): Change default value
- feat(YouTube): Replace with a fingerprint that supports a wider range of versions (..20.06)
- feat(YouTube - Hide action buttons): Add setting `Hide action button by index`, Remove patch option `Hide action buttons by index`
- feat(YouTube - Navigation bar components): Add user dialog message
- fix(YouTube): Playback speed sometimes changes to 1.0x in PiP mode (unpatched YouTube bug)
- fix(YouTube - Change live ring click action): Check more information for the guarantee of the more accurate operation of the patch
- fix(YouTube - Hide feed components): `Hide community posts` not working
- fix(YouTube - Remove background playback restriction): Play/Pause button not working in PiP mode https://github.com/inotia00/ReVanced_Extended/issues/2764
- fix(YouTube - Settings): HTML tags are not applied to some settings
- fix(YouTube - Snack bar components): `Invert snack bar theme` setting does not work in YouTube 18.29.38


YouTube Music
==
- feat(YouTube Music): Add support version `8.05.50`, Remove support version `8.02.53` https://github.com/inotia00/ReVanced_Extended/issues/2769
- fix(YouTube Music - Dark theme): Gradient is applied to the button of the action bar


Reddit
==
- fix(Reddit - Hide ads): Promoted ads showing in comments https://github.com/inotia00/ReVanced_Extended/issues/2678
- fix(Reddit - Hide ads): `View all comments` button hidden if comment ads are hidden https://github.com/inotia00/ReVanced_Extended/issues/2765
- fix(Reddit - Remove subreddit dialog): Patch fails at Reddit 2025.05.0+ https://github.com/inotia00/ReVanced_Extended/issues/2762
- fix(Reddit - Settings): Patch option key has not changed


Announcement
==
- **There is a change in `options.json`. If you see warnings related to patch options, remove the `options.json` file or `Patch options`.**
- YouTube Music's support version has been upgraded to **7.25.53 / 8.05.50**, but please read the following issue and upgrade only if necessary: [About 7.25.53](https://github.com/inotia00/ReVanced_Extended/issues/2554), [About 8.05.50](https://github.com/inotia00/ReVanced_Extended/issues/2769).
- Compatible ReVanced Manager: [RVX Manager v1.23.5 (fork)](https://github.com/inotia00/revanced-manager/releases/tag/v1.23.5).
